    <style type="text/css">
        .Panel11 {
            width: 100% !important;
            overflow-wrap: break-word;
        }

        .input-txt {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 20px 10px;
            border-style: none;
            font-size: 1em;
            color: black;
            border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.4);
            -moz-box-sizing: border-box;
            -webkit-box-sizing: border-box;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            -moz-transition: background-color 0.5s ease-in-out;
            -o-transition: background-color 0.5s ease-in-out;
            -webkit-transition: background-color 0.5s ease-in-out;
            transition: background-color 0.5s ease-in-out;
        }

        .input-Select {
            width: 100%;
            font: 0.875em "Tenor Sans", sans-serif;
            height: 40px;
        }

        .input-txt:-moz-placeholder {
            color: #e1184a;
        }

        .input-txt:-ms-input-placeholder {
            color: #e1184a;
        }

        .input-txt::-webkit-input-placeholder {
            color: #e1184a;
        }

        .input-txt:focus {
            background-color: #e1184a;
        }

        .fade.in {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .modal-title {
            margin: 0;
            line-height: 1.42857143;
        }

        .modal-body {
            position: relative;
            padding: 15px;
            top: -2px;
            left: 0px;
        }

        /* Bootstrap Modal Backdrop */
.modal-backdrop,
.ModalPopupBG,
.modalBackground,
.modalXBackground {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    z-index: 1040 !important;

    /* Make background hidden/dim */
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Modal should appear above backdrop */
.modal {
    z-index: 1050 !important;
}

.modal {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 1050;
    display: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    outline: 0;
}

/* Force modal overlay/backdrop */
body.modal-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
}

.modal-backdrop,
.opac-custom-backdrop {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
    z-index: 1040 !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

#mymodalupdate {
    z-index: 1050 !important;
     position: fixed !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
    z-index: 1040 !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

#mymodalupdate .modal-dialog {
    z-index: 1060 !important;
}

/* Modal content/panel */
.modal-dialog,
.modalPopup {
    position: relative !important;
    z-index: 1060 !important;
}

/* Stop background scrolling */
body.modal-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
}

/* Close button should always remain clickable */
.modal .close,
.modalPopup .close,
.close {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1060;
    cursor: pointer;
}

    <style type="text/css">
        /* Create three unequal columns that floats next to each other */
        .columnx {
            float: left;
            padding: 5px;
        }

            /* Left and right column */
            .columnx.side {
                width: 17%;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .columnx.side10 {
                width: 10%;
                text-align: center;
            }

            /* Middle column */
            .columnx.middle {
                width: 66%;
            }

            .columnx.middle85 {
                width: 78%;
                margin-left: 11px;
                min-height: 160px;
            }

            .columnx.middle90 {
                width: 90%;
            }

        .CurrentColor {
            /*color: green;*/
            box-shadow: 0px 0px 15px currentcolor;
            border: 0px solid currentcolor;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .columnx:hover {
            /*box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);*/
        }

        /* Clear floats after the columns */
        .rowx:after {
            content: "";
            display: table;
            clear: both;
        }

        /* Responsive layout - makes the three columns stack on top of each other instead of next to each other */
        @media screen and (max-width: 1000px) {
            .columnx.side, .columnx.middle, .columnx.middle85, .columnx.side10, .columnx.middle90 {
                width: 100%;
            }
        }

        /* Responsive layout - makes the three columns stack on top of each other instead of next to each other */
        @media screen and (min-width:1000px) and (max-width: 1300px) {
            .columnx.middle85 {
                width: 71%;
                margin-left: 45px;
            }

            .img_rpt {
                height: 165px;
                width: 125px;
                border-style: none;
            }
        }

        @media screen and (min-width:1300px) and (max-width: 1520px) {
            .columnx.middle85 {
                width: 74%;
                margin-left: 39px;
            }

            .img_rpt {
                height: 200px;
                width: 150px;
                border-style: none;
            }
        }



        /* Responsive layout - makes the three columns stack on top of each other instead of next to each other */
        @media screen and (max-width: 400px) {
            .content_container {
                padding: 2px;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .content_header {
                width: 100% !important;
                padding-left: 2px;
                padding-right: 2px;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .content_full {
                width: 100% !important;
                padding-left: 2px;
                padding-right: 2px;
            }



            .CurrentColor {
                /*color: green;*/
                box-shadow: 0px 0px 15px currentcolor;
                border: 0px solid currentcolor;
                padding: 15px;
                border-radius: 4px;
                box-shadow: 0 30px 45px rgba(35,31,32,.3);
            }



            .card {
                box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
                transition: 0.3s;
                border-radius: 5px;
            }

                .card:hover {
                    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
                }
        }
    </style>
